_note: Section 10. The player picks a form; materials determine everything else.

blade.name: Blade
blade.description: Edged. Converts material power into damage more efficiently than anything else.

robe.name: Robe
robe.description: Layered. Turns material power into standing ward instead of damage.

talisman.name: Talisman
talisman.description: Inscribed. Carries material effects more cleanly than it carries force.
